Coram : ARIJIT PASAYAT*, ALTAMAS KABIR
Practice and Procedure: Criminal appeal-Filed by accused-Dismissed by High Court on ground C of dismissal of criminal revision filed by informant-Held, dismissal of revision filed by informant cannot be ground for not discussing merits of appeal of accused-High Court to consider the appeal afresh IPC etc. The trial court convicted the appellants u/s 304(part 1)/34 IPC and acquitted the other accused. The appellants questioned their conviction in appeal before the High Court. The informant also filed a revision petition before the High Court for conviction of appellants u/s 302 IPC and
